description: Create a Suno task on RunAPI (add samples). Returns a task id, status, and output URLs.

audio_url.description: URL of the audio file to sample. Declared type: string.

callback_url.description: Webhook URL for async notifications. Declared type: string.

end_seconds.description: End of the sample range in seconds; must exceed start_seconds. Declared type: number.

model.description: RunAPI model slug for this model line.

prompt.description: Optional description of the sample to add. Declared type: string.

start_seconds.description: Start of the sample range in seconds. Declared type: number.

wait.description: Poll until the task reaches a terminal status.

name: add_samples
